name: Partner-Resisted Overhead Triceps Extension
steps: Stand with your elbows raised and hold one end of a towel behind your head in both hands.
Have your partner stand behind you and apply steady downward tension to the other end.
Extend your elbows forcefully to press your hands straight overhead against your partner's controlled tension.
Allow your elbows to bend slowly back behind your head while maintaining steady tension through your triceps.
tips: Communicate clearly with your partner so the resistance stays challenging yet smooth through both lifting and lowering.
Keep your elbows pointed upward rather than flaring wide to the sides.
